name: tankoban-nyaa-dark-gate
comment: Slice R1 (release gate for 1.1.1, 2026-08-21, 'nyaa ships dark'). Proves the manga Nyaa well is dark on a fresh install (mirrors Torrentio's own house-defaults treatment, native/engine/ExtensionsStore.cpp's removableWell rule), the per-volume picker shows an honest empty state naming the fix with a route to Extensions, and enabling Nyaa there makes the picker return live rows on the very next open -- no auto-enable, no nag, anywhere. Ground-truthed live via an interactive lanista session before being committed here (session 20260821-021437-00ff893e); this file mirrors that exact working step sequence, including the Extensions page's 'Installed' pane route (its default 'Sources' pane needs scrolling past two other worlds' rows to reach Tankoban's, which this scenario avoids entirely).

steps.label: the smoke session answers, drive gated on
one visible window, isolated data root
the boot splash has left the screen
a fresh tag gates world content behind account onboarding
continue without an account
onboarding dismisses
enter Tankoban
the Manga tab
One Piece - index 0 of the static 'Top in Tankoban - Manga' rail (malId 13, count_basis bookwalker -- a real shelf, so this is a genuine per-volume picker open, not the shelf-less series-search path)
One Piece's catalogue-fed masthead is ready
open the source picker on volume 1
the picker sheet is visible
the honest dark state: sourcesEnabled false, no rows, no compile fallback either
the empty-state route control is present and visible (a 'get' click never silently no-ops)
exhibit: the honest empty state naming the fix
the route to Extensions -- the ONLY way nyaa ever turns on
Extensions opens, landed on the Tankoban world (win.openExtensionsPage('tankoban'))
the Installed pane (short, no-scroll list -- avoids the Sources pane's Theatre-then-Tankoban scroll)

the pane switch settles before the next click resolves screen position (bridge coordinate-cache nuance ground-truthed this pass: a click fired immediately after a pane/tab switch can resolve a stale position)
nyaa starts off (matches the picker's own dark read a moment ago)
enable nyaa
the toggle actually landed
back out of Extensions (production Escape path)
regression: the series page is still showing One Piece underneath (Extensions was a layer over it, not a replacement)
close the still-open picker sheet (opening Extensions did not implicitly close it) so the next open is genuinely fresh
the picker sheet is fully closed (async-frame law: wait for the close animation to settle, not just the click reply)
reopen the source picker on volume 1 -- a fresh show()
the picker sheet is visible again

sourcesEnabled now true -- the toggle's effect reaches the picker with no restart -- THIS is Slice R1's own completion signal; live nyaa network results below are exhibit-only, never a deterministic gate
exhibit: the picker after enabling nyaa (best-effort grab, whatever the live nyaa search has produced so far -- structure only, no result-count or loading-state assertion)
